subject: Reschedule: Demo & Vendor Onboarding (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Demo of Redwood Inference - week of June 29

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We'd like to schedule a demo for our team to see Redwood Inference in action. Ideally sometime the week of June 29 (Wed/Thu morning PT would work best for us).

A couple of procurement/security notes so you know where we are: our vendor onboarding requires a completed security questionnaire and an executed NDA before we can run live demos with customer data. I'm copying Procurement here; they have the questionnaire ready and can start it now.

Proposed times:
- Wed, Jun 30, 9:00-10:00 AM PT
- Wed, Jun 30, 11:00-12:00 PM PT
- Thu, Jul 1, 10:00-11:00 AM PT

Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood needs the signed NDA/questionnaire in advance?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Carter
Head of Data Platforms
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Demo of Redwood Inference - week of June 29

Hi Alex —

Thanks — great to hear you're ready to move forward. Quick note from our security team: we require a fully executed NDA and completion of a short vendor security questionnaire before we run demos that will include any customer data or detailed architectures. If this demo is just a product tour with sanitized examples, we can be flexible, but for anything involving PII or your environment we'll need the onboarding steps completed first.

I'm attaching our standard NDA and the questionnaire here so your procurement/security team can start. If your team can sign the NDA and return the questionnaire by EOD Tue (Jun 30), we can try to keep the Wed morning slot — otherwise we should reschedule to early July to make sure security has time to review.

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf (draft), vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

Proposed backup: Tue, Jul 7, 10:00-11:00 AM PT

If helpful, I can loop in our security engineer (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) to accelerate review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Demo of Redwood Inference - week of June 29

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the NDA/questionnaire. Procurement will prioritize this and aim to return the signed NDA and completed questionnaire by EOD Tue (Jun 30).

If you can provisionally hold the Wed, Jun 30 9:00 AM PT slot, that would be ideal — otherwise we're happy to take Tue, Jul 7 at 10:00 AM PT if that's easier on your side.

I can also schedule a quick 15-min call Monday to walk through any questionnaire items if your security team has clarifying questions.

Appreciate it,
Alex

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Demo of Redwood Inference - week of June 29

Hi Alex —

Thanks for moving quickly here. I wanted to step in to confirm our security process so there's no surprises tomorrow: our policy is to require a fully executed NDA and a completed questionnaire reviewed by our security team before we run any demo that will show configuration details or ingest customer data.

We can do a product-only tour that uses sanitized examples tomorrow, but if you'd like to see integration behavior or anything tied to your data we do need the paperwork completed. Since procurement has indicated they'll aim for EOD Tue (Jun 30), security won't have time to review and sign off before the Wed morning slot. To avoid a last-minute cancelation, can we reschedule the demo to Tue, Jul 7 at 10:00 AM PT? That gives security time to go through the questionnaire and for us to circulate any follow-ups.

If you can get the NDA back before Tue, Jun 30 I can ask Rishi to do a quick pre-review and potentially keep the Jun 30 slot, but I don't want to risk your team showing up to a session we have to cut short.

Proposed new time: Tue, Jul 7, 10:00-11:00 AM PT

Thanks — looping Rishi for security review coordination.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmehealth.com>

Hi Vanessa / team —

Appreciate the clarity and we don't want to cause any extra work for your security team. Procurement will get the NDA signed and questionnaire back by EOD today; if security can do a quick pre-review that would be great, but we're happy to move the demo to Tue, Jul 7 at 10:00 AM PT to be safe.
